name: gizza-ai/readability-score
summary: Readability grades (Flesch-Kincaid, Gunning-Fog, SMOG) for text

tool.description: Score English text for readability and return the classic indices — Flesch Reading Ease (0–100, higher is easier), Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, Gunning-Fog Index, SMOG Index, Coleman-Liau Index and the Automated Readability Index — along with the counts they derive from (words, sentences, syllables, complex words) and a plain-language reading level. Runs locally; the text never leaves the device.

text.description: The text to score for readability.
